author: Psalm
text:
I’ve been building a meeting note-taking app.

You take your own notes while AI listens in the background, then helps you catch what you missed or misunderstood.

I’ve been obsessing over the UX and it’s finally starting to feel like a real product.

Here’s a little preview 👀
